subject: Payment posting instructions and statement for June (Boldbridge)
body:
From: Sara O'Neill <sara.oneill@boldbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@boldbridge.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: June statement + payment instructions (Boldbridge)

Hi Evelyn,

Attached is our June statement showing a single consolidated payment that should be applied across three open invoices (INV-20260411, INV-20260509, INV-20260529). Please confirm how Redwood will allocate the funds and whether you need a remit reference from our bank.

A few specifics: 
- Amount: USD 64,732.15 (single ACH)
- Bank reference: pending, we'll send wire confirmation once the ACH posts (expected today)
- We're happy to include an invoice-level breakdown if you prefer a remittance file (CSV).

Attachment: Boldbridge_Statement_June2026.pdf

Can you confirm the posting ETA and whether any VAT tagging is required on your side?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara O'Neill
AP Manager, Boldbridge Inc.
[sara.oneill@boldbridge.com]

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara O'Neill <sara.oneill@boldbridge.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: June statement + payment instructions (Boldbridge)

Sara — thanks for the statement. We received the file and are pulling the invoices into our clearing queue. A few quick notes: 

- We will apply the consolidated payment across the three invoices by oldest-first unless you provide a remittance csv specifying exact allocations.
- If Boldbridge can include your internal reference (e.g., BBX-4821) in the bank reference, that speeds reconciliation on our end.
- VAT: Redwood posts payments to net amount; any VAT tagging we need will come from the invoice metadata. If your remittance has VAT breakdowns, please include them.

Marcus and Laura — looping you both for any special posting instructions or if we should hold allocation pending the ACH trace.

Evelyn Hart
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Sara O'Neill <sara.oneill@boldbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: June statement + payment instructions (Boldbridge)

Evelyn / Sara — internal note on allocation plan: 

- We'll tentatively apply the USD 64,732.15 to INV-20260411 (USD 22,450.00), then to INV-20260509 (USD 18,142.15), and remainder to INV-20260529.
- Posting will occur once we receive the bank trace or wire confirmation image; please send even a PDF screenshot of the ACH confirmation. If there's any discrepancy in cents we will create an unapplied credit and notify Boldbridge.
- Please ensure the ACH reference contains BBX-4821; if you can't control that, include a remittance csv and we'll accept it via email/Drive.

Laura — can you confirm whether EU VAT flags are needed here? My read is US-only for this Boldbridge payment.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Accountant, Redwood Inference

---

From: Sara O'Neill <sara.oneill@boldbridge.com>
